title: Backtracking Agent Applications Security Incidents
abstract: arXiv:2611.26525v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agent applications are increasingly deployed, yet agent-specific attacks pose real threats to them. Upon a security incident, organizations backtrack to identify the CEP (compromise entry point), remediate the damage, and prevent its recurrence. The main artifacts available for backtracking are trajectory logs, which record agent functionalities, and source code; app(lication)-specific function call logs are often fairly limited. However, trajectory logs are at the agent functionality abstraction layer, while the CEP candidates are function calls at the app code execution layer. Due to this semantic gap, the analyst needs to manually inspect the relevant code for each CEP candidate to infer its corresponding agent functionality. In this work, we present Origin, a backtracking tool for the analyst to submit a small number of queries to identify CEPs that existing tools cannot provide. tldr: 该论文提出了Origin回溯工具，通过弥合智能体轨迹日志与应用代码执行层之间的语义鸿沟，让分析人员仅需提交少量查询即可自动识别智能体应用安全事件的入侵入口点。
